mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, code,file_type, first_category_id, first_category_name
mapper.select: SELECT A.attach_name AS attachName, A.attach_url AS attachUrl FROM file_management fm LEFT JOIN attachment A ON fm.file_id = A.ID AND A.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fm.sku_id = #{skuId} AND fm.file_type = 'categoryGeneralStandard' AND A.ID = ( SELECT a2.ID FROM attachment a2 WHERE a2.ID = fm.file_id ORDER BY a2.attach_version DESC LIMIT 1 );
